trustee.en: The school trustee attended the meeting about campus improvements.
trustee.zh: 學校董事出席了關於校園改善的會議。

truthful.en: A truthful report should clearly separate facts from opinions.
truthful.zh: 誠實的報告應清楚區分事實與意見。

tub.en: The art room keeps brushes in a plastic tub.
tub.zh: 美術教室把畫筆放在塑膠盆裡。

tube.en: The poster was stored safely inside a cardboard tube.
tube.zh: 海報安全地收在紙筒裡。

tuck.en: Please tuck the loose paper into the back of your folder.
tuck.zh: 請把鬆散的紙張塞進資料夾後面。

tug.en: The child gave the rope a gentle tug during the game.
tug.zh: 遊戲中，那個孩子輕輕拉了一下繩子。

tuition.en: The university website lists tuition and other student fees clearly.
tuition.zh: 大學網站清楚列出學費與其他學生費用。

tumble.en: Several books began to tumble from the unstable stack.
tumble.zh: 幾本書開始從不穩的書堆上掉下來。

tuna.en: The sandwich contains tuna, lettuce, and sliced tomato.
tuna.zh: 這份三明治裡有鮪魚、生菜和番茄片。

tune.en: She hummed a familiar tune while organizing her notes.
tune.zh: 她整理筆記時哼著熟悉的旋律。

tunnel.en: The train entered a long tunnel beneath the mountain.
tunnel.zh: 火車進入山下的一條長隧道。

turmoil.en: The novel describes a family living through political turmoil.
turmoil.zh: 這本小說描述一個家庭經歷政治動盪的生活。

turtle.en: A turtle rested on a rock beside the pond.
turtle.zh: 一隻烏龜在池塘旁的石頭上休息。

tutor.en: The tutor helped the student review difficult grammar points.
tutor.zh: 家教老師協助學生複習較難的文法重點。

tv.en: The documentary will air on tv later this evening.
tv.zh: 這部紀錄片今晚稍晚會在電視播出。

twice.en: I checked the calculation twice before submitting the worksheet.
twice.zh: 我在繳交學習單前把計算檢查了兩次。

twig.en: A small twig fell onto the path after the storm.
twig.zh: 暴風雨後，一根小樹枝掉在步道上。

twilight.en: The sky turned purple as twilight settled over the hills.
twilight.zh: 黃昏籠罩山丘時，天空變成紫色。

twin.en: Each twin chose a different topic for the class project.
twin.zh: 這對雙胞胎各自選了不同的班級專題主題。

twinkle.en: Stars began to twinkle as the sky grew darker.
twinkle.zh: 天色變暗時，星星開始閃爍。

twist.en: The story takes an unexpected twist near the final chapter.
twist.zh: 故事在最後幾章出現意想不到的轉折。

typhoon.en: The school closed early because a typhoon was approaching.
typhoon.zh: 因颱風接近，學校提早放學。

ultimate.en: Our ultimate goal is to make the project clear and useful.
ultimate.zh: 我們最終的目標是讓專題清楚又實用。

umbrella.en: She left her umbrella beside the classroom door.
umbrella.zh: 她把雨傘留在教室門邊。

unanimous.en: The committee reached a unanimous decision after a short discussion.
unanimous.zh: 委員會經過短暫討論後達成一致決定。

uncle.en: My uncle works as an engineer in another city.
uncle.zh: 我的叔叔在另一個城市擔任工程師。

unconditional.en: The scholarship offers unconditional support for approved educational expenses.
unconditional.zh: 這項獎學金對核准的教育支出提供無條件支持。

uncover.en: The investigation may uncover useful information about the system error.
uncover.zh: 調查可能揭露關於系統錯誤的有用資訊。

underestimate.en: Do not underestimate how much time careful editing can require.
underestimate.zh: 不要低估仔細編輯所需要的時間。

undergraduate.en: The program is open to every undergraduate at the university.
undergraduate.zh: 這項計畫開放給大學裡每位大學生參加。

underground.en: The city built an underground passage beneath the busy road.
underground.zh: 城市在繁忙道路下方興建了一條地下通道。

underline.en: Please underline the key sentence in each paragraph.
underline.zh: 請在每段的關鍵句下畫線。

underneath.en: The missing notebook was underneath a pile of textbooks.
underneath.zh: 遺失的筆記本在一堆課本下面。

underpass.en: Pedestrians use the underpass to cross the wide road safely.
underpass.zh: 行人使用地下道安全穿越寬廣道路。

underway.en: Repairs are already underway in the old science building.
underway.zh: 舊科學館的修繕工程已經進行中。

undo.en: Use the undo button if you delete the wrong sentence.
undo.zh: 如果刪錯句子，可以使用復原按鈕。

undoubtedly.en: Regular practice will undoubtedly improve your familiarity with the vocabulary.
undoubtedly.zh: 規律練習無疑會提升你對這些單字的熟悉度。

unemployment.en: The report examines changes in unemployment during the economic slowdown.
unemployment.zh: 報告探討經濟放緩期間失業情況的變化。

unfold.en: The full story began to unfold during the second interview.
unfold.zh: 完整故事在第二次訪談中逐漸展開。

unification.en: The chapter discusses the political unification of several neighboring regions.
unification.zh: 這一章討論幾個鄰近地區的政治統一。

union.en: The workers' union met with management to discuss working conditions.
union.zh: 工會與管理階層會面討論工作條件。

unite.en: Shared goals can unite people from different backgrounds.
unite.zh: 共同目標可以團結不同背景的人。

unity.en: The team showed strong unity during the difficult competition.
unity.zh: 團隊在艱難比賽中展現高度團結。

universe.en: The lesson explores how scientists study the expanding universe.
universe.zh: 課堂探討科學家如何研究正在膨脹的宇宙。

unlock.en: This password will unlock the digital practice materials.
unlock.zh: 這組密碼可以解鎖數位練習教材。

unprecedented.en: The city experienced unprecedented rainfall during the storm season.
unprecedented.zh: 這座城市在暴雨季經歷前所未有的降雨量。

unveil.en: The school will unveil its new library design next week.
unveil.zh: 學校將在下週公開新的圖書館設計。

upgrade.en: The computer lab will upgrade its software during the holiday.
upgrade.zh: 電腦教室將在假期期間升級軟體。

upload.en: Remember to upload your report before the deadline tonight.
upload.zh: 記得在今晚截止前上傳報告。

upright.en: Keep the box upright while carrying it to the classroom.
upright.zh: 把箱子搬到教室時請保持直立。
